name: University of Akron
academic_ranking: Public research university (R2) in Akron, OH, part of the University System of Ohio. Notable for engineering and polymer science/polymer engineering programs (nationally recognized). Broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs.
financial_aid: Out-of-state undergraduate tuition approx $20,815; in-state (Ohio resident) approx $13,135 (2024-25, source: univstats). Athletic scholarships available for softball; institutional need- and merit-based aid also offered. Specific per-athlete scholarship figures not publicly listed.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at Lee Jackson Field on the University of Akron campus. Athletics facilities under the GoZips/Akron Athletics program.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Mid-American Conference (MAC). Head coach Craig Nicholson leads the program.
notes: Staff directory (gozips.com/sports/softball/coaches) fetched live 2026-07-30; listed 3 softball staff (1 head coach, 2 assistant coaches). No recruiting coordinator, director of player development, or graduate/volunteer assistant separately listed on the public staff page.
